Scope, method, and attribution

The local cached speech model supplies transcription and estimated word times. It does not establish speaker identity, authenticity, intelligibility, emotion, or background-noise absence. Noise, reverb, music, overlap, and perceptual cues require a separate listening pass. No voice-origin detector was run. No audio was sent to an external API.

Transcription model: openai/whisper-base.en, pinned revision 911407f4214e0e1d82085af863093ec0b66f9cd6. Word alignment can be inaccurate. Source text was consulted only after the model output was generated. This is a reference-informed demonstration, excluded from blind annotation results, model evaluation, and reviewer agreement.

Source: LibriSpeech, Panayotov et al. · CC BY 4.0 · source 2094-142345-0010 · first 30 seconds of a 30.615-second recording. Unmodified PCM samples, cropped and encoded as lossless WAV. Public audiobook text includes fictional names.
